title: The Eagle's Eyrie
text: An eagle's nest on a crag, as big as a cart, woven from whole saplings and lined with the bones of sheep and men. The eagle is away hunting. Its eggs are not, three of them, mottled and warm, each the size of a child's head.

options.label: The quickest climbs to the nest, to see the land as the eagle does.

outcomes.text: From the top they glimpse the whole land, bones and all, then climb down safely.
The eagle comes home. It is very large and very angry, and it goes for the eyes.

options.label: Take an egg to sell, while the eagle is away hunting.

outcomes.text: The egg fetches a fine price. All the next day the eagle hunts you, screaming from the sky.

options.label: Pass under the crag quietly, and leave the eagle to its bones.

outcomes.text: A feather drifts down, long as an arm. You keep it; it stays warm.
